box_agent_run.rationale: Runs an AI agent inside a box with shell, filesystem, and git access. Unbounded action under the account's authority.

box_exec.rationale: Arbitrary shell command execution inside a box container.

box_manage.rationale: Creates, deletes, pauses, resumes, and forks boxes. Deletion destroys container state.

box_preview.rationale: Mints public URLs for services running inside a box, with basic_auth and bearer_token as opt-in flags. Publishes an internal service to the internet; revocable by deletion.

box_runs.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): list and get are reads; only cancel mutates, and a cancelled run can simply be started again.

box_snapshots.rationale: Creates, deletes, and restores filesystem snapshots. A restore silently rolls back everything since the snapshot.

qstash_get_user_token.rationale: Credential disclosure. Returns a reusable QSTASH_TOKEN. The bridge also refuses it in code, but that protects only this proposer implementation; the plugin entry is what stops another proposer being routed pass-through.

qstash_logs_get.rationale: Pass-through (read): one message log entry with body.

qstash_publish_message.rationale: Sends an HTTP request to an arbitrary destination URL through the queue, and can trigger workflow runs. An egress and side-effect channel.

qstash_schedules_manage.rationale: Creates, updates, pauses, resumes, and deletes schedules — standing automation that keeps firing with no human present.

redis_database_delete.rationale: Destroys a database and its keyspace.

redis_database_manage_backup.rationale: Creates, deletes, and restores backups. Both deletion and restore are destructive.

redis_database_reset_password.rationale: Rotates the database password, breaking every existing client and issuing new credentials.

redis_database_run_redis_commands.rationale: Arbitrary Redis commands, including FLUSHALL and DEL.

redis_database_set_daily_backup.rationale: Enables or disables daily backups. Disabling produces no visible failure; the loss appears only when recovery is needed.

redis_database_update_regions.rationale: Changes read regions, altering replication topology, latency, and cost.

util_dates_to_timestamps.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): local date arithmetic. Touches no account at all.

util_timestamps_to_date.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): local date arithmetic. Touches no account at all.

workflow_dlq_manage.rationale: Deletes, restarts, and resumes failed workflow runs. A restart re-executes side effects.
